items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: I didn't have to go and stay with Aunt Jane or Aunt Martha or whatever; I'd just stay in the place, you know.

ctx.x: When you played with him, you played drums, huh? Like a piano and drum combo. I just wanted to make it clear for the record.

During those periods in different parts and places I've been and always running around, when the show gets stranded in what area - Chattanooga, Louisville, Paducah, or what area - they'd come over and ask me from those roadhouses, you come over and play in this band. I was integrating then. They knew me as Jo. I'd come in and play with these bands. I didn't know nothing about white and colored. I just thought it was music, just so nobody don't bother my drums, I knew where I'd stand. I didn't have to go and stay…
